description: The single most structurally important Part 6 batch: compiles JUCINQC (03-09, solutions/03-09/jucinqc.clp) and the JUCINQ command (03-11, src/qcmdsrc/jucinq.cmd) for the first time in this library (neither has been compiled in <USER>2 before, per docs/part03/03-09/03-11's own 実機メモ), pointing JUCINQ's CPP at JUCINQC as a baseline. Calls JUCINQ TOKCD('C00001') once as a baseline (JUCINQC's own SNDPGMMSG-per-order output, captured via VFYLOG). Then compiles P0612A (PRTF, DDS keywords SPACEB/SKIPB/EDTCDE - EDTCDE confirmed via ilerpgprogguide75.txt, SPACEB/SKIPB NOT confirmed against either fetched RPG reference per f0612s.rpgle's own header) and F0612A (**FREE, program-entry dcl-pi matching JUCINQC's exact CHAR(6) interface, verified against jucinqc.clp/jucinq.cmd/03-09's lesson text directly - see f0612s.rpgle's header), calls F0612A directly with the same TOKCD to compare against R0408A's already-verified output (ACME TRADING CO / J00001 / J00003) via its own printed report, captured as spooled-file text (same CPYSPLF-to-permanent-PF technique verify/part06-01-cvtrpgsrc/manifest.json already established, since PRTF output is a spooled file, not a job-log message). FINALLY performs the CPP swap itself: CHGCMD CMD(&LIB/JUCINQ) PGM(&LIB/F0612A) - per cl_commands_75.txt, this does not alter JUCINQ's own parameter validity checking, so the same TOKCD('C00001') call should now run F0612A instead of JUCINQC. Calls JUCINQ once more post-swap to confirm this - the first real V2 confirmation of the CPP-swap mechanism this repo has attempted (design doc section 0.4).

steps.label: VSPLPF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYSPL) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) RCDLEN(133) TEXT('Part 6 spooled-file text capture'))

steps.label: CAPF0612A
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(P0612A) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.label: CAPPOSTSWAP
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(P0612A) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)
